title: Seal dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <style>
      .body { fill: #6b7280; }
      .light { fill: #9ca3af; }
      .belly { fill: #d1d5db; }
      .eye { fill: #1f2937; }
      .nose { fill: #374151; }
      .whisker { stroke: #e5e7eb; stroke-width: 1.5; }
      .fin { fill: #4b5563; }
    </style>
  </defs>
  <!-- water puddle/floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#3b82f6' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- tail fin (curled up) -->
  <path d='M 68 70 Q 82 62 76 48 Q 82 60 88 58 Q 76 72 72 76 Z' fill='#4b5563'/>
  <path d='M 68 70 Q 78 66 80 56 Q 74 66 72 76 Z' fill='#6b7280'/>

  <!-- body: curving, dancing seal -->
  <path d='M 34 78 Q 18 78 17 64 Q 16 50 28 44 Q 40 38 52 42 Q 62 45 66 56 Q 72 68 62 76 Q 52 82 40 80 Z' fill='#6b7280'/>

  <!-- belly light patch -->
  <path d='M 32 74 Q 24 74 23 64 Q 23 54 32 50 Q 42 46 48 52 Q 52 60 48 68 Q 42 75 32 74 Z' fill='#d1d5db'/>

  <!-- back flipper raised (dancing!) -->
  <path d='M 58 50 Q 66 38 60 26 Q 70 36 74 30 Q 68 48 66 56 Z' fill='#4b5563'/>
  <path d='M 58 50 Q 63 42 62 32 Q 64 44 66 56 Z' fill='#9ca3af'/>

  <!-- front flipper -->
  <path d='M 30 60 Q 22 56 18 48 Q 26 52 34 58 Z' fill='#4b5563'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#6b7280'/>

  <!-- snout light patch -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#d1d5db'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#374151'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='37' r='4' fill='#1f2937'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#1f2937'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='35.5' r='1.3' fill='#e5e7eb'/>
  <circle cx='53.3' cy='36.7' r='1.1' fill='#e5e7eb'/>

  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M 24 52 Q 30 57 36 52' stroke='#1f2937' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line class='whisker' x1='21' y1='47' x2='10' y2='44'/>
  <line class='whisker' x1='21' y1='49' x2='10' y2='50'/>
  <line class='whisker' x1='22' y1='51' x2='12' y2='56'/>

  <!-- little music note -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#f472b6'/>
  <rect x='80' y='14' width='2.5' height='17' fill='#f472b6'/>
  <path d='M 80 14 Q 88 16 86 24 Q 84 18 80 17 Z' fill='#f472b6'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M 14 26 L 15 31 L 20 32 L 15 33 L 14 38 L 13 33 L 8 32 L 13 31 Z' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <path d='M 85 70 L 85.7 73 L 88 73.7 L 85.7 74.4 L 85 77 L 84.3 74.4 L 82 73.7 L 84.3 73 Z' fill='#fbbf24'/>
</svg>
